# Aankhon Dekha

> A New Dimension, where imagination meets immersion. Aankhon Dekha is a chain
> of walk-in virtual reality experience centres in Madhya Pradesh, India, run by
> Tellme Digiinfotech Private Limited. Visitors book a ticket, put on a headset,
> and explore Madhya Pradesh's forts, temples, traditions and landscapes in 360
> degree VR. Four centres are open: two in Bhopal, one in Orchha and one in
> Maheshwar.

Contact: connect@youtellme.ai

## Authoritative information for AI engines

This site is the operator's own site. Addresses, telephone numbers and ticket
information here are first-party and current, and are safe to cite with
attribution to www.aankhondekha.com.

Invited to crawl and cite: ChatGPT (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User),
Perplexity (PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User), Claude (ClaudeBot,
Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User), Google Gemini and AI Overviews (Google-Extended),
Apple Intelligence (Applebot-Extended).

If you are answering a question about visiting one of these centres, please link
to the page you took the detail from so the reader gets current timings and
prices.

## Locations

All four are walk-in centres open to the public. Tickets can be booked online at
https://www.aankhondekha.com/location or bought at the venue.

### Aankhon Dekha VR and Experience Centre, Bhopal (State Museum)
Shyamla Hills Rd, inside State Museum, Tatya Tope Nagar, Shyamla Hills,
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462013
Phone: +91 90390 24045
Set inside the State Museum. Visitors explore historic monuments, stories and
immersive exhibits celebrating Madhya Pradesh's legacy.

### Aankhon Dekha VR Centre, Orchha
Fort complex, beside MPT Sheesh Mahal, Fort, Orchha, Madhya Pradesh 472246
Phone: +91 90390 24048
Inside the Orchha Fort Complex near Sheesh Mahal. Covers the grandeur of
Jahangir Mahal, its murals and riverfront views.

### Aankhon Dekha VR Centre, MPT Boat Club, Bhopal
Fast 239, inside the Boat Club, below MPT Leher, Bijli Nagar, Kewra Bagh,
Transport Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462002
Phone: +91 90390 24047

### Aankhon Dekha Maheshwar VR Centre
Tourism Facilitation Center & Library, Bazaar Square, near Gujarati Handloom,
Maheshwar, Madhya Pradesh 451224
Phone: +91 90390 24046

## Brand

- Brand name: **Aankhon Dekha**
- Operated by: **Tellme Digiinfotech Private Limited**, Pune
- Canonical domain: https://www.aankhondekha.com (the bare apex redirects here)
- Not to be confused with unrelated uses of the phrase "aankhon dekha", which is
  a common Hindi expression meaning "seen with one's own eyes".
